name: Stonewatch Falls
summary: Water spills into a murloc-claimed pool at Stonewatch Falls, beneath Stonewatch in the eastern Redridge Mountains.

sections.title: A Perilous Mountain Basin
sections.body: Stonewatch Falls pours down the slope beneath Stonewatch, the Blackrock orc stronghold. Its water runs from Lake Everstill’s eastern river and gathers in a deep pool against the mountainside. Murlocs have claimed the shore with crude reed hovels, and prey on travelers who come too close to the water.

faq.q: Where does the water from Stonewatch Falls come from?
faq.answer: The river from Lake Everstill’s eastern side feeds Stonewatch Falls. It tumbles downhill into a mountain basin beneath Stonewatch’s cliffs.

faq.q: What creatures live around Stonewatch Falls?
faq.answer: A tribe of murlocs occupies the shore, feeding on fish from the deep pool. They build rough shelters along its banks.

faq.q: Is Stonewatch Falls connected to Stonewatch Keep?
aliases: is stonewatch keep near the falls
faq.answer: Stonewatch Falls lies below Stonewatch and its ruined keep. Blackrock orcs hold the heights, while murlocs occupy the basin below.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the murlocs at Stonewatch Falls add to the dangers facing travelers in eastern Redridge.
